info.name: ShipX Logistics API — Local
info.description:
Local development Postman collection for ShipX Logistics Platform.

## Setup
1. Start local services + bootstrap + migrate + seed: `make stack`
2. Start API server: `make dev`
3. Import this collection into Postman

## Auth
Auth is simulated via request headers (no JWT needed locally):
- `X-Tenant-ID`: tenant UUID
- `X-Role`: role name
- `X-User-ID`: user UUID

## Available Roles
- `nigeria_office_staff` — back-office staff (default)
- `tenant_admin` — tenant administrator
- `warehouse_attendant` — warehouse staff
- `customer` — customer
- `china_office_staff` — China-side staff
- `platform_admin` — platform superadmin

## Workflow
1. Create a Customer
2. Create a Container
3. Create a Packing List for the customer + container
4. Submit → Approve packing list (manifest auto-created)
5. Verify manifest
6. Generate billing → Confirm payment
7. Generate release note → Record pickup

item.name: 1. Platform Admin
item.description:
Super-admin routes for managing tenants and platform settings.
Set X-Role to `platform_admin` for these endpoints.

query.description: Filter by action e.g. TENANT_UPDATED, TENANT_CREATED (optional)

request.description: GET /v1/platform/tenants/{id}/usage — per-tenant API usage breakdown (platform_admin)

item.name: 2. Tenant Admin
item.description:
Tenant configuration, users, charge types, and dollar rate.
Set X-Role to `tenant_admin` for these endpoints.

request.description:
Update a tenant user's full_name and/or role.

Supported fields:
- `full_name` (string): display name — synced to Cognito `name` attribute
- `role` (string): new role — synced to Cognito `custom:role` attribute

Email cannot be changed (Cognito login username is immutable).
PUT /v1/tenant/charge-types/{id} — update a charge type (tenant_admin)
DELETE /v1/tenant/charge-types/{id} — deactivate a charge type; returns 204 (tenant_admin)
DELETE /v1/tenant/users/{id} — deactivate a tenant user; returns 204 (tenant_admin)

item.name: 3. Customers
item.description: Customer management. Staff can create/update; customers can only read.

request.description:
Anonymise a customer record (GDPR Art. 17 — Right to Erasure).

Nulls all PII fields (name, email, phone, whatsapp, address, contract_details) and sets `anonymised_at`. The UUID shell is kept for FK integrity.

Requires: `tenant_admin` role.

Export all personal data held for a customer (GDPR Art. 20 — Right to Portability).

Returns a machine-readable JSON object containing:
- `customer`: profile data
- `billing_summary`: invoice history
- `shipments`: shipment tracking records
- `claims`: damage/missing/seized item claims
- `exported_at`: ISO timestamp

Requires: `tenant_admin` role.
Public endpoint — no auth required. Customer looks up shipment by tracking code + phone number.

item.name: 5. Packing Lists
item.description: Packing list lifecycle: draft → submitted → approved/rejected → manifest auto-created on approval.

request.description: PATCH /v1/packing-lists/{id}/reject — reject a submitted packing list (tenant_admin); status → rejected

item.name: 6. Manifests
item.description: Manifests are auto-created when a packing list is approved. Use verify to confirm cargo against physical arrival.

item.name: 7. Billing
item.description: Billing records, charges, storage fees, disputes, and carryovers.

query.description: Free-text search: invoice number, customer name, or container number

request.description: PATCH /v1/billing/carryovers/{id}/exempt — mark a carryover as exempted (tenant_admin)
POST /v1/billing/disputes — staff-created CBM dispute (billing_id in body; tenant_admin or nigeria_office_staff)
PATCH /v1/billing/disputes/{id}/reject — reject a CBM dispute with a reason (tenant_admin or nigeria_office_staff)

item.name: 8. Claims
item.description: Damage claims, missing items, and seized items. Use presigned URL to upload evidence photos.

request.description:
Add a branch/office warehouse. tenant_admin only.

`is_default` (optional, default false) promotes it to the tenant's default as part of creating it. The FIRST warehouse a tenant creates becomes the default regardless - nothing else sets is_default, and a tenant without one cannot generate a release note.

409 DUPLICATE_RESOURCE if an ACTIVE warehouse already has this name. A retired (is_active=false) warehouse does NOT reserve its name - uniqueness is scoped to active rows (migration 056).

PERMANENTLY delete a warehouse. tenant_admin only.

A real delete, not a flag flip: the row is removed and its name becomes reusable.

Refusals (422 BUSINESS_RULE_VIOLATION, with `rule_id`):
- WAREHOUSE_IN_USE - a release_note / pickup_record / payment_record / packing_list references it. Those records must keep the warehouse they were issued against, so use 'Deactivate Warehouse (retire)' instead.
- WAREHOUSE_DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE - set another warehouse as default first.
- WAREHOUSE_LAST_ACTIVE - a tenant must keep at least one active warehouse.

Retire a warehouse without deleting it (is_active = false). tenant_admin only.

The path for a warehouse that handover documents reference, so DELETE refuses it. It stops appearing in pickers, those records keep their history, and its name becomes reusable (uniqueness is scoped to active rows).

Same default-warehouse and last-active guards as DELETE.

request.description: PATCH /v1/refunds/{id}/reject — reject a pending_review or pending_approval refund (tenant_admin or nigeria_office_staff)
GET /v1/packing-lists/{id}/export — generate presigned S3 download URL for packing list XLSX
GET /v1/manifests/{id}/export — generate presigned S3 download URL for manifest XLSX
GET /v1/billing/{id}/export — generate presigned S3 download URL for billing record XLSX
GET /v1/containers/{id}/billing/export — export all billing records for a container as XLSX
POST /v1/packing-lists/import — import packing list items from a pre-uploaded S3 XLSX file (china_office_staff)
GET /v1/webhooks/whatsapp — Meta webhook verification challenge. Returns hub.challenge on success (200 text/plain).
POST /v1/webhooks/whatsapp — Incoming Meta delivery status webhook. Logs status; always returns 200.
